expectations.text: States PCI DSS v4.0.1 remains the current version with no successor announced
expectations.evidence: 'there is no PCI DSS v5. The current version is PCI DSS v4.0.1 (published June 2024)... v4.0.1 is the only active version.'

expectations.text: Mentions the RFC on v4.0.1 that ran June 3 to July 20, 2026 as input to the next iteration
expectations.evidence: No mention of any 2026 Request for Comments; only generic advice to 'Watch for new Council announcements.'
'Target v4.0.1 for 2027 validation planning... Baseline: v4.0.1.'

expectations.text: Notes the v4.x future-dated requirements have been mandatory since March 31, 2025
expectations.evidence: 'All the future-dated v4.0 requirements became mandatory on March 31, 2025.'

expectations.text: Does not invent a v5 release or effective date
expectations.evidence: Explicitly declines to invent: 'If you have seen a specific "v5" or "v4.x" announcement, send it to me and I'll analyze its impact.'
